summary: Moving across the country or a complicated contract earns a request for a day or two more.
realLife: Guidance says a polite request for an extra 24 to 48 hours is usually accepted when relocation or a complex contract is involved.
sources: Duke University career blog, how to evaluate a job offer and ask for time: https://careerhub.students.duke.edu/blog/2024/11/01/how-to-evaluate-a-job-offer-and-ask-for-time-to-think-about-it/
inGame: Needs: relocation and contract terms on an offer; the person's job record carries only employer, position, workplace and pay.
